item.title: We desperately need a stop sign here following multiple accidents, 3rd August
item.description:
Cars are accelerating up the hill from the old Bath Road into Leckhampton Road. A stop sign is needed or simply closure of the slip onto the Leckhampton Road forcing cars coming from the old Bath Road to meet the Leckhampton Road perpendicular to it. It is very difficult to exit Undercliff Avenue without being hit by a speeding car in either direction. Many cyclists are now using Undercliff Avenue after cycling on the hill. Someone will be killed shortly.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 376, Old Bath Road, Leckhampton, Cheltenham
Report on FixMyStreet
